brief: Trial NCT03738423 (Regeneron, phase 2). Status, stated reason for stopping quoted exactly, enrollment, and when results were posted relative to the approximate due date.

findings.notes: Confirmed in snapshot and live record.

findings.claim: Trial NCT03738423 stated reason for stopping is "Lack of efficacy", categorized under efficacy.
Trial NCT03738423 results were first posted on June 10, 2022, which is 454 days late relative to the approximate due date of March 13, 2021.
findings.notes: Primary completion date was March 13, 2020, making the results due date March 13, 2021.

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.sponsor, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, d.results_due_date, d.results_posted, t.results_first_post_date, d.days_late FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT03738423';
